title: Garuda/Prime
extract:
Release Date: March 28th, 2022
 Garuda Prime is the Primed variant of  Garuda, sporting increased Energy and Armor, and an additional  polarity, with her  Garuda Prime Talons also having improved Damage and Critical Chance over  Garuda Talons. She was released alongside the  Nagantaka Prime and  Corvas Prime.

Acquisition

Vaulted
On January 17th, 2024, Garuda Prime, along with Nagantaka Prime and Corvas Prime, entered the Prime Vault and were retired from the reward tables. Any preexisting components or fully-built items remained as is.
Garuda Prime,  Corvas Prime, and  Nagantaka Prime can occasionally be acquired via Prime Resurgence.

Crafting

Notes
 Garuda Prime, compared to  Garuda:
Higher Armor (420 vs. 315)
Higher Energy (220/320 vs. 140/240)
Higher Starting Energy (100 vs. 50)
Additional  Polarity ( vs. )
More powerful Exalted Weapon ( Garuda Prime Talons vs.  Garuda Talons)
If Garuda Prime wields her Signature  Nagantaka/ Nagantaka Prime, the weapon gains a 1 meter innate Punch Through.
As with any other Prime Warframe, moving close to the location of an Orokin Void Death Orb will restore a pulse of 250 Energy to nearby allies, even if that Death Orb is inactive, destroyed, or non-present. This effect can only occur once per orb.
Garuda Prime possesses the highest base Energy reserves of all Warframes: 220 at rank 0 and 320 at rank 30.
Garuda Prime's  Dread Mirror sports an Orokin-designed frame around the conjured mirror, and  Blood Altar and  Seeking Talons's Talons are colored gold and crimson, matching Garuda Prime's colors.

Trivia
Garuda Prime is the eleventh Primed Warframe whose non-Primed variant was unlockable through a quest (Vox Solaris), after  Harrow,  Nidus,  Gara,  Octavia,  Inaros,  Titania,  Atlas,  Chroma,  Limbo, and  Mirage.
Garuda Prime is the first Primed Warframe whose Exalted Weapon possesses different stats compared to her standard counterpart.
Treating her Talons as a unique weapon due to having modified stats, Garuda Prime is the first Prime Warframe (followed by  Khora Prime) to have three Prime items released together (in Garuda's case, Nagantaka Prime, Corvas Prime, and her Talons). Other Prime Warframes have at most two new Prime items, and those who do have Prime Exalted Weapons (such as  Mesa Prime's  Regulators Prime) have the same stats as their standard counterparts.
